scope: Initial English open-weight evidence index, prioritizing Phonon-2 and small ASR models. Public source research only; no local model evaluation was performed.
caveats: The maintainer CSV and Fermion launch table differ: Phonon-2 AMI 9.32 vs 9.37 and LS clean 1.73 vs 1.72; Parakeet v3 VoxPopuli 3.05 vs 3.19. Keep both protocols and their labels.
The CSV avg column does not mean Fermion's original seven-set panel. Only explicit per-dataset columns are imported. The UI seven-column mean is derived and never saved as a measured result.
Both accuracy tables belong to one evidence family; split count is not evidence-family coverage. There is no aggregate rank.
Maintainer publication does not identify every run operator or establish independent reproduction.
A download in MB, a parameter count, an installed package and peak runtime memory are distinct. Voxtral's parameter-derived 8,000 MB estimate is excluded from observed sizes.
Do not apply the original Qwen3-ASR release date to a later -hf conversion; unknown exact release dates remain null. No Hub repository creation date is used as release evidence.
The separate Phonon-1 model card reports an eight-set evaluation and other WER values; it is not merged into the seven-set Phonon-2 launch table.
Mac, CPU and NVIDIA batch throughput use different workloads and runtimes. No streaming latency, USD per audio hour, energy or RAM values are inferred.
next_evidence: Matched Moonshine and Whisper tiny/base measurements on a pinned shared protocol.
Independent noise/accent, long-form, multilingual and silence/hallucination evaluations with exact checkpoint and scorer revisions.
Same-machine measurements of real-time factor, p50/p95 streaming latency, cold/warm starts and peak RAM; keep batch and single-stream modes distinct.
Hosted reference models with pinned generation and direct USD per audio hour tariffs; do not substitute open-weight results or convert token prices without an observed workload.
